add_metadata_to_mmcif: add AlphaFold metadata including authors, citation, software, and pLDDT metrics to an mmCIF dictionary
review_add_metadata_to_mmcif: review the add_metadata_to_mmcif function to understand how it populates ModelCIF conformance and quality metrics
refactor_add_metadata_to_mmcif: refactor add_metadata_to_mmcif to support custom author lists or citation details instead of hardcoded values
test_add_metadata_to_mmcif: test add_metadata_to_mmcif with a sample mmCIF dictionary and model type string to verify metadata output
summarize_add_metadata_to_mmcif: summarize how add_metadata_to_mmcif computes global pLDDT from B-factor values and extracts atom type symbols
